# Wave Runner's sound 68000 (waverunr, epr-19284): The House of the Dead's
# driver (seeds/hotdo_snd.txt), six bytes earlier from 0x60070a. Jump tables
# of bra.w entries at 0x60070a (7), 0x6028c2 (8), 0x602afa (7); of bra.s
# entries at 0x600298 (7, the eighth entry the code after them); of word
# offsets at 0x6011bc (81), 0x601f60 (16) and 0x6024e2 (21); and lea/jmp into
# the unrolled move.l runs at 0x601c3e (128) and 0x601d46 (128), every entry
# and the code after. Addresses only (rules.md).
